name: nf_initiatives_search_config
description: Search configuration for the nf-initiatives SearchIndex, syn75081635. Default analyzer is the built-in STANDARD (tokenize + lowercase, no stemming) so the initiative name/free-text stays searchable; per-column overrides (org.synapse.nf-nf_initiatives_columns) route id-like fields (abbreviation, website, initiativePath) to IDENTIFIER, the summary to the nf_scientific_synonyms analyzer, and fundingAgency to KEYWORD. Bind only to syn75081635.
